name: Mesh Winding Number Voxelization
definition: A method to determine inside/outside of a mesh at a point by computing a hierarchical evaluation of the Mesh Winding Number. For closed meshes, it yields an integer inside and 0 outside; for meshes with holes, it diffuses smoothly around boundaries.
summary: Mesh Winding Number Voxelization determines mesh interiors via scalar fields, uniquely handling non-manifold geometry and holes unlike ray-casting methods.
